howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Slack 渠道:它会从 channels 分支复制 Slack 适配器、注册并安装固定版本的依赖,构建后跑注册测试,再带你创建 Slack 应用、收集令牌,最后重启服务。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加 Slack 渠道时触发;可在 /setup 流程中执行,装完后用 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 完成接线。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Slack 渠道。
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试。

say.text: 带我创建 Slack 应用,用 Socket Mode 配令牌。
say.note: 逐步引导创建应用并收集 xoxb-/xapp- 令牌。

say.text: 用 webhook 方式接入 Slack。

howto.what_en: Adds a Slack channel to NanoClaw: it copies the Slack adapter from the channels branch, registers and installs it, builds and runs the registration test, then guides Slack app setup, stores your tokens, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Slack as a channel to NanoClaw. It can run inside /setup, and afterwards you wire it with /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add a Slack channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs the registration test.

say_en.text: Walk me through creating the Slack app in Socket Mode.
say_en.note: Guides app creation and collects xoxb-/xapp- tokens.

say_en.text: Set up Slack with webhook delivery.
say_en.note: Uses a public HTTPS Request URL instead of the socket.
